title: Establish the reference before judging the port
description: The early reference JSON records a narrower frontier than later notebook runs. The later icon-grid capture is retained in the same record as an explicitly later result; it is not retroactively assigned to the early run.

title: Capture the live handoff
description: The N45AP live tree reports a 6 MHz timebase and 24 MHz fixed clock where the archived timebase is zero. A separate entry capture records PC 0x080607ec and r0 0x0866c000; the native model reaches a CPU-specific instruction frontier, not a completed boot.

title: Separate translation, interrupt routing and input ABI
description: At VA 0x40000054, the recorded L1 and L2 descriptors exist and resolve into backed RAM, yet the model reports DFSR 6. The control keeps the PTE fixed. Separate IRQ routing and touch ABI reports on this date address independent contracts.

title: Observe a real legacy memory exchange
description: Physical userspace reaches SWP at PC 0x2fe25724, opcode 0xe1002091, with address 0x2fe3c788 and old value zero. The success receipt and the earlier undefined-instruction register dump belong to different runs.

title: Check declared time against elapsed time
description: The nominal one-second delay changes from 3.014805055 s at a declared 62.5 MHz to 1.010080943 s at 24 MHz. UART-bracketed elapsed time is enough to detect this large scale error; it is not a precision timer characterization.

title: Follow client pixels into the panel
description: The physical display record distinguishes a deliberate pattern from original-client imagery, while QEMU supplies a separate visible reference. Charging reports bracket native intervals with recovery-mode battery samples; they do not provide an in-interval current trace.

title: Connect a physical edge to visible wake
description: Three physical Power down/up pairs traverse the original HID path. Visible setup imagery returns after blanking. Volume edges are mapped to Home in these experiments; this does not establish guest volume adjustment or physical touch.

title: Separate two contacts from one visible pinch
description: The long packet trace did not establish pinch. A later finger-identity trial accepted visible Photos enlargement and brightness, with clean storage checks.

title: Measure battery balance during native execution
description: The initial bright screen drew from the battery while blanked idle replenished it; original consumer wiring is separately checked with synthetic QEMU samples.

title: Reduce atomic traps, retain uncertain UI benefit
description: Mean trap rates fell 98.50–99.91% in one paired replay; frame gaps did not improve consistently.

title: Accept a separate physical iPhone home screen
description: M68 unlock, Settings and Photos touch pass alongside clean reboot and unchanged reference volumes.

title: Recover a stock native screenshot
description: One 320 × 480 M68 lock-screen TIFF becomes a pixel-identical PNG; the reported pause remains unmeasured.

title: Cross from a dark raw frame to live Camera preview
description: The raw transfer and owner-accepted viewfinder are separate records. Native delivery is about 29.5/s; distinct selection is about 7.9/s.

title: Save real VGA photos and reopen them after reboot
description: Two JPEGs keep their hashes across a fresh boot, with accepted gallery display and full data-volume checks.

title: Reproduce the image-retirement bottleneck in isolation
description: Original ARM bookkeeping with synthetic images identifies capacity and producer reserve as separate constraints; physical comparison remains pending.

title: Measure the larger legacy Camera queue
description: One physical two/six-slot comparison separates native delivery, distinct selection and panel update counters.

title: Share adapters across 4A102 and 7E18
description: Kernel-hash-selected bindings carry independent newer storage/AES and service contracts.

title: Reach 3.1.3 UI and the physical selector
description: English UI is captured in QEMU; the physical display/input replay uses synthetic contacts.

title: Accept the clean stock 3.1.3 Camera route
description: Owner accepts preview, shutter, thumbnail and Photos; initial UART and pre-reboot hash gaps remain explicit.

title: Drain before native power-off and reset
description: Clean halt is accepted; one direct EL2→WDOG0 confirmation reaches the selector. Ordinary repeatability stays pending.

title: Boot and recover without an SD card
description: The existing eMMC bootloader reaches selector/Jumpdrive; a pre-XNU RTC-only stall has bounded recovery.

title: Accept the daily cold-power-cycle workflow
description: Real touch, Camera/Photos and complete halt are hand-tested; the new photograph opens after cold power-on.

title: Measure finite raw sensor samples
description: 100 real samples and bounded restoration do not establish stock rotation or client lifetime.

title: Separate idle timing from animation
description: A 64-presentation zero-change interval measures elapsed display work without a cache/clock change.

title: Advance USB to listener readiness
description: Enumeration and mux pass; a later sampled listener follows initial host preflight. Ordinary pairing remains pending.

title: Rank future targets without claiming ports
description: The offline ranking and partial 10B500 QEMU clock-gate frontier retain separate acceptance classes.
